name: Notes Capture
description: Capture passing notes, thoughts and voice notes into the vault.

agents.name: Notes Manager
agents.primary_routing_snippet:
- **`notes-manager`** -- quick capture, no decision needed. Route here for
  anything that's content to log rather than a request to act on: a passing
  thought, something overheard, a transcribed voice note, a reminder. There's
  no Q&A to run first -- relay the content verbatim (don't paraphrase or
  summarize it down) in one call, e.g.:
  `terminal(command="hermes -p notes-manager chat -q \"<the content, as given>\" -Q")`.
  This is also your catch-all for unclassified TEXT.
